```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```


## 311 rat call data 2020 - 2026
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
nyc_311_2020 = 
  read_csv("data/nyc_311_2020.csv") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(
    unique_key,
    created_date,
    problem_formerly_complaint_type, 
    problem_detail_formerly_descriptor, 
    location_type,
    incident_address,
    borough, 
    latitude,
    longitude
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    created_date = as.Date(lubridate::mdy_hms(created_date))
  )

# General view of data
view(nyc_311_2020)

#Summary based on types of 311 calls
descriptor_summary = 
  nyc_311_2020 |> 
   mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(created_date),
    complaint = problem_detail_formerly_descriptor
  ) |>
  filter(
    year >= 2020,
    year <= 2026
  ) |>
  group_by(year, complaint) |>
  summarize(
    n = n_distinct(unique_key),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(year)

#tidy readable table
descriptor_summary|>  
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = complaint,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |> 
  knitr::kable()

#plots
descriptor_plot = 
  descriptor_summary |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = complaint)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)
descriptor_plot
```
